title: JSON Schema Validation & Type Coercion
description:
Implement JSON Schema validation and type coercion from docs/plans/01-ai-core.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §9 (JSON Schema Validation)

Key deliverables:
- CoerceTypes function: pre-validation type coercion (string→int, string→float, string→bool, string→null, nested objects, arrays). Modifies args in-place. Handles coercion failure gracefully (leave original value).
- ValidateToolArguments: validates tool call arguments against JSON Schema. Calls CoerceTypes first, then validates via jsonschema lib, copies coerced values back on success.
- ValidateToolCall: finds tool by name in slice, delegates to ValidateToolArguments
- Schema compilation cache: keyed by xxHash of schema content. sync.RWMutex, double-checked locking pattern. Cache hit metrics via slog structured logging (URP §16.1).
- formatValidationError: clear error messages with JSON paths
- External deps: github.com/santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/v6, github.com/cespare/xxhash/v2
- Unit tests (table-driven): valid args pass, invalid args fail, type coercion cases, missing required fields, unknown tool error
- Test harness tests: P4 (CoerceTypes preserves valid types), F2 (JSON schema validation fuzz), F3 (CoerceTypes fuzz), S3 (schema cache under varied load: cold, hot, mixed), B4 (validation benchmark, target <50μs with warm cache), B5 (schema compilation cold benchmark, target <500μs), Sec1 (malicious schema injection: recursive $ref, deep nesting, huge enum, regex DoS)
- All tests must pass with -race flag

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/01-ai-core.md §9
- Test harness: docs/plans/01-ai-core-test-harness.md §1 (P4), §3 (F2, F3), §4 (S3), §5 (B4, B5), §7 (Sec1)
- Depends on: Core Types & EventStream (aiag-qkh.1) — uses Tool and ToolCall types
